summary: AkzoNobel filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report; US equivalent of an 8-K) disclosing a UK CMA Phase 1 decision on its proposed merger with Axalta Coating Systems. The CMA identified competition concerns solely in UK vehicle refinish coatings. AkzoNobel and Axalta will offer the same remedy package agreed with the European Commission — divestment of AkzoNobel's European VR coatings business, including the UK arm. No price or premium is stated. The companies target completion by early 2027; the combined entity would have roughly $17 billion in revenue. Watch CMA Phase 2 referral risk versus remedy acceptance and EC/CMA timing alignment.
